response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-relevant tools, plus strong architecture and open-source contributions, but his seniority level (Staff/Senior roles since 2014) vastly exceeds the entry-level requirement, and his German language proficiency is only basic despite high on-site presence being required.
strengths: Deep TypeScript and full-stack experience across React, Node.js, and REST APIs
Proven track record in scalable systems, DevOps, and open-source architecture
Strong learning ability demonstrated through diverse tech stacks and workshops
concerns: Overqualified with 10+ years of senior experience, risking misalignment with junior role expectations
Basic German proficiency conflicts with high on-site presence requirement in Berlin
Recent roles focus on AI-agent infrastructure and DLang, which may distract from core renewable energy platform needs
